source: NCERT Class IX, India and the Contemporary World I, History Ch. 2.

sections.heading: 1. Ideas of Socialism
points: **Socialism** = the idea that **property (land, factories) should be owned by society/the state**, not by private individuals — to end exploitation and inequality.
**Karl Marx** and **Friedrich Engels** developed 'scientific socialism' (**communism**); Marx wrote **Das Kapital** and (with Engels) the **Communist Manifesto**.
Marx: workers (**proletariat**) would overthrow the capitalists (**bourgeoisie**) and build a classless society.

sections.heading: 2. Russia before 1917
points: Russia was an **autocracy** under **Tsar Nicholas II** (Romanov dynasty); most people were **poor peasants**; industry was growing but workers had harsh conditions.
The **1905 Revolution** (after **'Bloody Sunday'**) forced the Tsar to allow an elected **Duma**, but he soon curbed it.
**World War I** brought huge losses, food shortages and discontent.

sections.heading: 3. The Two Revolutions of 1917
points: **February Revolution (1917):** strikes and protests in **Petrograd**; the **Tsar abdicated** → a **Provisional Government** formed. (Monarchy ended.)
**October Revolution (1917):** the **Bolsheviks**, led by **Lenin**, seized power; workers' councils = **soviets**.
Bolsheviks made peace (**Treaty of Brest-Litovsk**, exiting WWI), nationalised industry and land.

sections.heading: 4. After the Revolution
points: A **civil war** (Reds vs Whites); the Bolsheviks won and formed the **USSR (Soviet Union, 1922)**.
After Lenin's death, **Stalin** took power → **collectivisation** of agriculture and rapid **industrialisation (Five-Year Plans)**, but with great hardship and repression.
The Russian Revolution inspired **socialist and communist movements worldwide**.

sections.heading: 5. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Socialism = social/state ownership of property; Marx & Engels = Communist Manifesto, Das Kapital.
Russia = autocracy under Tsar Nicholas II (Romanov); 1905 Revolution (Bloody Sunday) → Duma.
February 1917 = Tsar abdicated (Provisional Government); October 1917 = Bolsheviks/Lenin seize power.
Workers' councils = soviets; USSR formed 1922.
Stalin = collectivisation + Five-Year Plans.

sections.heading: 6. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: The **February Revolution ended the monarchy**; the **October Revolution brought the Bolsheviks (Lenin)** to power.
**Soviets** = workers'/soldiers' councils.
**Marx & Engels** wrote the **Communist Manifesto**; Marx alone wrote **Das Kapital**.
**Collectivisation and Five-Year Plans** are associated with **Stalin**, not Lenin.
